methods.label: Complementary events and independence
methods.explanation:
Interpreting “here” as the independent-shot setting, complementary events and independence are sufficient. “No hits” is the complement of “at least one hit,” so
\[
P(\text{at least one hit})=1-P(\text{no hits}).
\]
Independence lets us find the probability of no hits by multiplying the individual miss probabilities. No additional event, such as the first shot being a hit, is assumed known to have occurred, so conditional probability is not required. Conditional probability is covered in the selective compulsory curriculum. Thus, under this interpretation, the answer is B (No).
methods.levelReason: The explanation uses complementary events and multiplication for independent events, both within the stated required curriculum. No conditional-probability formula is needed.
